ns2:section.sectionText: This is an in-person flipped format class. There are no traditional lectures. Instead, students complete pre-lecture videos and assignments delivered online. During the class sessions students will work on group assessments, which must be completed during class. Classroom attendance is required. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/CSregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS: Computer Sci OFF - UIUC or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
